neighbours.label: The token just before a word of leadership or direction is expected (under the ⟦the⟧ command/direction of, bajo ⟦la⟧ dirección, co-⟦cha⟧ired, ⟦prés⟧idé par, he ⟦hel⟧med), i.e. a predictor of who leads or directs, across languages; 'under the' with a physical object stays low.
fire: The choir sang the requiem under the direction of its new music director.
The battalion crossed the river under the command of a young major.
El coro cantó bajo la dirección de su nuevo director musical.
La comisión, presidida por la ministra, presentó su informe en marzo.
Le comité, présidé par un ancien juge, rendra ses conclusions en juin.
The inquiry will be co-chaired by a retired judge and a professor of law.
For ten seasons she helmed the club through two promotions.
The excavation was carried out under the supervision of the national museum.
quiet: The choir sang the requiem under the old stone arches of the cathedral.
The battalion crossed the river under heavy rain in the early morning.
El coro cantó bajo la lluvia en la plaza del pueblo.
La comisión, reunida en Madrid, presentó su informe en marzo.
Le comité, réuni à Lyon, rendra ses conclusions en juin.
The inquiry will be held in the town hall and open to the public.
For ten seasons she played for the club in two different positions.
The excavation was carried out under a plastic roof to keep the rain off.

notes: Probes (fraction of max 266): 'bajo la dirección' 0.749 (' la'), 'under the direction of' 0.571 (' the'), 'co-chaired' 0.560 ('cha'), 'présidé par' 0.412, 'under the command of' 0.371, 'helmed' 0.241. Quiet: 'under the bridge' 0.210 (a leak risk), 'under a different title' 0.083, plain prose 0.003. The + pole's logit effect suppresses leadership, helm, lead, led, pres, directing, direction, so the - pole promotes them: a next-word predictor.
